transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Carter, the S-3. Before I publish the final staffing roster for the coordination cell during the upcoming four-day field exercise, we need to run our routine pre-exercise qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. We've got three desks to fill — partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control — and three available personnel: Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. Each desk requires a current applicable qualification. I'd like to start by confirming what qualifications each of these three soldiers currently holds, so we can match them to the right desks. Who has visibility on that?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Maj. Carter. I can speak to the partner-liaison qualification. I confirmed in the personnel database this morning that Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, making Malik the qualified choice for the partner-liaison desk. The renewal was confirmed today, though I should note the updated qualification export is not yet on the S-3 briefing slide.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Maj. Carter. From the logistics side, I can speak to the POL-accountability qualification. During my latest supply inspection, I verified that Cpl Ortiz is the only one of the three available personnel with current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification, making Ortiz the qualified choice for the POL-accountability desk. I should note that the inspection update has not yet been entered in the roster tracker, so it may not show up if you're checking that system.
